investigations.name: TS-Dynamic-Objects-v2
investigations.result: Skipping the empty setter preserves [], but a singleton list becomes the scalar 42. The final JSON composition preserves both shapes.

investigations.name: TS-Dynamic-Matrix / v2 / v3
investigations.result: Unresolved. Nested array literal processing crashes BackgroundShortcutRunner before object composition. The tested direct-array state variant and recursive JSON backend did not fix it and were removed. Dynamic nested array embedding is explicitly rejected; the pre-existing nested-literal failure outside this path remains documented.

limitations: Data must be JSON-compatible. Native numeric precision and dictionary ordering apply.
JSON composition adds native actions and serialization work.
Dynamic containers in array literals or native dictionary(...) parameter field states remain unsupported; use attachment() where the action accepts a dictionary variable.
Dynamic nested/mixed/recursive arrays in object literals are rejected. Direct nested array literals can still compile elsewhere but have a known native runtime failure.
The direct setDictionaryValue wrapper retains native empty/singleton-list behavior; the new object construction handles those cases explicitly.
Physical devices, other OS versions, real HTTP requests and every Shortcuts capability remain unverified.
